TFB
THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK-TO-BACK

Episode III

The Empire Strikes Back-To-Back

Turmoil has engulfed the TFB League. Three champions have risen, three dynasties have fallen, and the trophy has never rested long in the same hands.

In 2023, IAN arrived as a rookie who had never played a single week. The veterans laughed at his draft board. He did not lose again. He led the standings from Week 1 to Week 17, wire to wire, and took the crown in his very first season.

In 2024, ANDRE was gutted by injuries before October. Star after star fell. But he never flinched. Week after week he started exactly the right man at exactly the right hour, squeezing wins out of a broken roster, and he lifted the trophy on nerve alone.

In 2025, JAKE was decimated. His lineup collapsed to almost nothing by midseason. So he traded. Deal after deal after deal, he rebuilt his team from the wreckage in real time, and he bargained his way straight through the playoffs to the title.

Now the survivors gather again. Old grudges smolder, the draft board waits, and somewhere in the darkness a fourth name prepares to be written....
